notes: Format example only: invented town, invented sources. Not used in runs unless --include-synthetic.
claim: Unemployment in Exampleton doubled last year.

evidence.quote: the unemployment rate in Exampleton rose from 2.1 percent to 4.2 percent over 2025
evidence.context: Annual labour figures were released today. They show the unemployment rate in Exampleton rose from 2.1 percent to 4.2 percent over 2025. The figures are seasonally adjusted.

evidence.quote: the 2024 figure was unusually low because a temporary hiring programme ended in January 2025
evidence.context: Analysts caution against reading the change as a collapse. They note the 2024 figure was unusually low because a temporary hiring programme ended in January 2025. The 2025 rate is close to the ten-year average.
